goal.original: Weigh the inpaint node Fabio found (and the open Klein 9B thread) before writing any of the Flow, then wire the app half if the pipeline survives.
goal.summary: It did not survive - it got smaller. LanPaint replaces the whole-image relight AND the ~25-node composite-back tail, measured on all five plates, and Klein 9B beats 4B on every one. But Fabio's eye caught a defect every metric here missed: the BOX EDGE is visible. Fixing that comes before any app wiring.

completed: THE ROUTE IS MEASURED AND IT WORKS (commit d484257c). stamped composite + a BOX mask -> InpaintCropImproved (optional_context_mask = MpiMaskSquareBbox(mask,64)) -> ImageScaleToTotalPixels(1MP, steps 16) -> VAEEncode -> ReferenceLatent -> FluxGuidance 4.0 -> SetLatentNoiseMask(cropped_mask) -> LanPaint_KSampler(4 steps, cfg 1.0, euler/simple, denoise 1.0, NumSteps 2, 'Image First', 'Image Inpainting') -> VAEDecode -> InpaintStitchImproved. Wiring COPIED from Fabio's two bench workflows, not invented.

IT DELETES the whole-image Klein relight AND the ~25-node tail (ImageBlend x2 + screen, ImageToMask, both ThresholdMask, both GrowMaskWithBlur, MaskComposite, the 100px proximity gate, the full-frame ImageCompositeMasked). The tail only ever repaired a global re-grade and there is no longer one.
MOVEMENT IN THE USER'S PHOTO OUTSIDE THE BOX: 0.04-0.36, against session 3's bg_mean 3.45 (silhouette) / 10.34 (shadow-aware). Structural - the stitch returns the original outside the box.

SPEED: 4B 16.1s, the SAME wall clock as session 5's 74-node merged graph. 9B 30.1s (1.9x) and BETTER ON ALL FIVE PLATES by eye - clearest on indoor (shadow aligns with the window beam) and overcast (grass crosses the legs). Confirms Fabio's read positively.

BOX SIZE IS THE WHOLE CONTROL, both ways. A tight box STRUCTURALLY CANNOT cast a shadow (shadow_ratio 0.015-0.054); auto (+25% out, +60% down) wins on all five; generous (+60%/+120%) RE-GRADES what it contains (far_frac 0.68 sun / 0.66 overcast / 0.43 anime).

DECIDED WITH FABIO: the flow gains a `box` step. MpiStepBox ALREADY EXISTS and already feeds Mpi Box Mask / Mpi Box Crop, so it is a data line, not a component. Its `hint` asks for ROOM, never light direction - the model reads the scene's light itself. Crop-stitch is IN (it also answers small-subject-in-a-big-image).
Evidence, runners and every number: .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-567/research/lanpaint/verdict.md. Sheets at D:/WORK/Images/Outputs/mpi567/lp/.

next_action.description: Fix the visible box edge - it is the one thing between this route and the app wiring. Work the four candidates in research/lanpaint/verdict.md cheapest-first (mask_blend_pixels 32->96/128, then denoise<1.0, then ImageCompositeMasked against the ORIGINAL cropped_image before the stitch, then splitting crop bounds from denoise mask), re-running seamzoom.py after each. The bar is edge_step under 2 on sun/overcast/anime; never judge it on night or indoor, which under-report. Do NOT start the FlowDef until the edge is gone.

key_decisions: THE RE-GRADE DID NOT GO AWAY - IT BECAME A UI PROBLEM. Sessions 2-5 fought it in the graph with a 25-node tail. LanPaint's noise mask removes the premise (unmasked latents survive the denoise), but an over-large box still re-invents the photo inside it. Better place for it - but it is now one drag-handle away at all times, which is why the auto-seed and the step's hint are load-bearing rather than cosmetic.

EVERY METRIC IN THE VERDICT MISSED THE SEAM, AND THE FAILURE MODE IS INSTRUCTIVE. `outside` looks BEYOND the box, where the stitch guarantees the original - it can never see this defect. `far_frac` returned None for `auto` because that box has no area far from the object, and that None was read as 'cannot re-grade'. It cannot re-grade AT DISTANCE; it can still shift tone across the whole box. Fabio's eye beat the instrumentation. Add edge_step (seamzoom.py) to any future judgement of this route.

PROBABLE CAUSE OF THE SEAM IS NOT THE SAMPLER. InpaintStitchImproved pastes back the WHOLE inpainted crop, and that crop was VAE round-tripped and rescaled to 1024x1024 (output_resize_to_target_size: True). Every pixel inside the box drifts, hidden only by mask_blend_pixels: 32 - enough for a small step, not an 11. LanPaint preserves the LATENT, not the decoded pixels.

`ring` MEASURED ON THE CHANGED REGION'S OWN BBOX IS INVALID FOR THIS ROUTE and must not be quoted. The noise mask is a rectangle, so that bbox hugs the box and the ring band lands on real content (object, shadow), reading 7-20 on visually clean results. Session 3's numbers were valid because its changed region was a feathered blob well inside its bbox. Use edge_step and far_frac.

9B NEEDS qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors, not 4B's qwen_3_4b. The mismatch dies with `mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied (512x7680 and 12288x4096)`, which reads as a LanPaint bug and is not one. Already documented in MPI-600 research/format.md; re-derived here at the cost of one wasted sweep - read that file before touching 9B.

SCOPE ESCAPED THIS CARD. LanPaint is landing in the SHIPPED klein_t2i_template, not this flow's private graph, so the node_lock.json pin reaches every Klein op in the app. Fabio has a separate agent on 9B + the new 4B template, and the CHARACTER SHEET flow rides the same 4B inpaint route. MPI-567 CONSUMES that template; it must not be the card that pins a third-party sampler into every Klein path. Overlaps MPI-598 and MPI-600.
